reasons.reason: Taking 25 percent of the forty-dollar price gives ten dollars, and that ten-dollar figure is exactly what the discount produces when it is applied to this shirt.
A 25 percent discount on a forty-dollar shirt takes ten dollars off, and subtracting that from the original price leaves thirty dollars as the amount actually paid.
